fixture_purpose: Demonstrates that lead_auto is no longer phase-gated; it reaches server-side decision artifact verification and fails closed when the decision artifact is missing, stale, hash-mismatched, wrong-target, or instruction-mismatched.

evidence.mechanism: trigger_kind == 'lead_auto' validates lead_decision_artifact_id, lead_decision_artifact_sha256, continuation_instruction_sha256, current run/stage/agent/session identity, required safety checks, and requested budget before any admission row or ProcessContinuation work item is created.
evidence.hold_predicate_prevented: Missing, changed, stale, wrong-target, unsafe, over-budget, unreadable, invalid-JSON, and hash-mismatched lead decisions are rejected before admission.
